query:
SELECT u.id AS "user_id!",
                   (u.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(u.last_name, '')) AS "name!",
                   COUNT(r.id)::bigint AS "referral_count!"
            FROM referrals r
            JOIN users u ON u.id = r.referrer_id
            GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name
            ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC
            LIMIT 10
